original_job.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Radar
original_job.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Radar ML team builds the machine learning systems that power Stripe’s Radar fraud and abuse product suite. Our models make real-time decisions across a significant share of internet commerce - helping businesses stop fraud, increase authorization, and grow safely. By turning economy-scale datasets into compelling ML products, the team directly improves customer outcomes and drives meaningful revenue for Stripe. The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle, adaptive and customizable fraud systems for enterprises, and risk intelligence for 50+ global payment methods. What you’ll do You will lead the machine learning strategy for abuse prevention across the full customer lifecycle. Abuse doesn't stop at the payment. Bad actors create fake and duplicate accounts, take over legitimate ones, farm free trials and promotions, resell access they obtained below cost, use services they never intend to pay for, and file bad-faith refunds and disputes. For AI companies, every abusive account burns real compute, and the same actors keep moving from one account, product, and access path to the next. Stripe is uniquely positioned to solve this. Our network sees consumers across millions of businesses, so we can recognize a bad actor at signup, at login, at payment, and long after. Radar has already shipped the first building blocks: account evaluations at signup and login, customer-level abuse risk, and APIs that let businesses report their own abuse outcomes. You will turn these building blocks into a unified abuse prevention layer that understands the consumer behind every event and helps businesses act consistently across all of that consumer's accounts. This is a large growth opportunity for Radar, and a strategic priority for Stripe. This is a fast-moving 0→1 area, built alongside some of the world's leading AI companies, and the attacks are real today. Labels are sparse, delayed, and differ by business. Much of the customer journey is only partly visible to us. Adversaries adapt as soon as we ship. You will set the technical direction, make the hard architecture calls, and personally build the hardest pieces. Responsibilities Set the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for lifecycle abuse ML, with product and engineering leadership: which abuse vectors to take on, in what order, and with what approach. Design a persistent, continuously updated consumer risk profile that combines signals from signups, logins, payments, product usage, refunds, and disputes. Evolve it from explainable composite scores toward model-driven risk scores for each type of abuse. Lead development of models for abuse vectors such as multi-accounting, account takeover, bots, free-trial and promotion abuse, unauthorized resale, non-payment, refund abuse, and friendly fraud. Use graph, sequence, and LLM-based approaches over payment, account, and product-usage data. Solve the label problem by designing ways to learn from sparse, delayed, merchant-specific, and weak labels, including merchant-shared feedback, LLM-assisted labeling, and network-level signals. Define how we measure success: evaluation frameworks, impact and ROI estimates, and operating-point guidance that help businesses trade off abuse losses against growth and conversion. Turn detection into action by shaping the risk controls, interventions, and recommendations businesses can turn on at each step of the customer journey. Stay deeply hands-on: write substantial production code, prototype quickly, and personally land the most technically difficult components, with the reliability and latency standards of systems in Stripe's critical path. Break ambiguous problems into parallel workstreams, unblock other engineers, and raise the team's bar through design review, code review, and mentorship. Partner directly with leading Stripe users, fraud experts, product, and adjacent Stripe teams to ground the work in real user pain and change course quickly based on what you learn. Build AI-native tooling, agents, and workflows that let the team investigate attacks and build and operate models dramatically faster. Who you are You are a hands-on technical leader who has built ML systems that matter, shipped them to production, and led others in doing the same. You thrive in ambiguity. You can take an open-ended problem with messy data and incomplete labels, find the highest-leverage path, get to user impact quickly, and change course when the data says so. You make the engineers around you better. You're as comfortable talking with a customer about the economics of their abuse problem as you are debugging a feature pipeline. You're excited to use frontier AI both in the systems you build and in how you build them. We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 10+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment. A track record of technically leading large, ambiguous ML initiatives from problem definition to production, with measurable business impact. Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design, including where labels are noisy, delayed, or scarce. Strong software-engineering skills, and you remain a hands-on contributor who regularly writes tested, maintainable production code. Experience designing and operating production ML systems at scale, including data and feature pipelines, real-time inference, deployment, and monitoring, and making architecture tradeoffs across them. Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineers or teams, and mentoring engineers to grow their scope. Ability to explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product leaders, and customers, and to build alignment across functions. Preferred qualifications Experience applying ML to fraud, abuse, integrity, trust and safety, identity, or security, where adversaries actively adapt to your defenses. Experience with entity resolution, graph learning, or behavioral and sequence modeling of users, accounts, or devices (for example, detecting multi-accounting, account takeover, or bots). Experience productionizing modern deep learning or LLM-based approaches, including using LLMs for labeling, investigation, or detection. Experience building 0→1 ML products and working directly with customers to define what to build. Experience building shared ML platforms, representations, or foundation models used across multiple products or teams. Experience building AI-assisted tooling or agents that measurably increased a team's velocity.

original_job.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Product and Risk Data Engineering is Stripe's single source of truth data engineering layer for Payments, Risk, and Product — we enable Stripe to confidently run, measure, and grow the business by making accurate information easy to access. We curate and maintain high-quality data warehouses and pipelines that serve as the authoritative foundation for product and financial activity across Stripe, powering analytics, ML capabilities, agentic workflows, and merchant-facing data interfaces. Beyond building data, we act as the internal experts in data technologies and partner with Data Platform to deliver high-quality, low-friction data processing frameworks. We also serve as the bridge between data producers and data consumers — championing best-in-class data engineering practices and guiding product teams on event-driven data API modeling — so that every team at Stripe can build, decide, and grow from a trusted, well-engineered data foundation. What you’ll do We're looking for a person who could contribute to the team by solving high-impact, cutting-edge data problems. The ideal candidate will be someone that has built data pipelines for large scale volume, is deeply knowledgeable of key tools including Airflow/Spark/Kafka/Flink, is empathetic, excels at building strong relationships, and collaborates effectively with other Stripe teams to understand their use cases and unlock new capabilities. Responsibilities Lead the technical outcomes for a team of ambitious, talented engineers, providing mentorship, guidance, and support to ensure their success Partner with our recruiting team to attract and hire top talent Deliver cutting-edge data pipelines that scale to users' needs, focusing on reliability and efficiency Develop strong subject matter expertise and manage the SLAs of data pipelines and full stack web applications that support critical stakeholders Collaborate with product managers and peers across the company to create/improve canonical datasets and data warehouses, use golden paths, and ensure Stripes and customers are using trustworthy data Leverage AI/LLM and Agents at scale to produce and analyze high-quality data on ambiguous problems Have the opportunity to drive the execution of key data initiatives for Stripe, overseeing the entire development lifecycle from planning to delivery while maintaining high standards of quality and timely completion Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements This is a Staff-level role — that typically means 10+ years of experience building and operating data systems, pipelines, warehouses, infrastructure, and leading teams to deliver exceptional solutions A strong engineering background and passion for data as well as prior experience with writing and debugging data pipelines using a distributed data framework An inquisitive nature in diving into data inconsistencies to pinpoint issues, and resolve deep rooted data quality issues Knowledge of a backend development language (such as Scala, Java, or Go) and strong SQL experience Extreme customer focus, with a commitment to partnering with product, leaders across the business, and other Stripe engineers to understand their use cases Effective cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to think rigorously, communicate clearly, and make or coordinate difficult decisions and trade-offs Thrive with high autonomy and responsibility in an ambiguous environment Ability to foster and work in a healthy, inclusive, challenging, and supportive work environment Preferred qualifications Our stack is made up of Iceberg, Kafka, Change Data Capture, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Hive Metastore, Pinot, Trino, and AWS Cloud - experience with all or some of these tools is a huge plus Influencing open-source contributions Experience creating and maintaining data marts / warehouses to power business reporting needs Experience collaborating with Product, Go-To-Market, or Sales / Marketing teams Genuine enjoyment of innovation and a deep interest in understanding how things work, with the ability to question and direct architectural decisions Strong written and verbal communication skills for various audiences, including leadership, users, and company-wide
